esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_billing_cost_lookup, serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup, serverless_project_contribution_lookup, serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup, serverless_project_status_lookup, serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup, serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup, serverless_billing_credits_lookup METADATA _index
| EVAL threshold_stale_hours = 36.0
| EVAL is_bc = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_billing_cost_lookup"),
       is_rp = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup"),
       is_pc = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_project_contribution_lookup"),
       is_dc = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup"),
       is_ps = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_project_status_lookup"),
       is_ai = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup"),
       is_sy = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup"),
       is_cr = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_billing_credits_lookup")
| STATS
    bc_last = MAX(CASE(is_bc, event.ingested, null)), bc_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_bc, @timestamp, null)), bc_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_bc, 1, null)),
    rp_last = MAX(CASE(is_rp, event.ingested, null)), rp_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_rp, @timestamp, null)), rp_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_rp, 1, null)),
    pc_last = MAX(CASE(is_pc, event.ingested, null)), pc_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_pc, @timestamp, null)), pc_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_pc, 1, null)),
    dc_last = MAX(CASE(is_dc, event.ingested, null)), dc_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_dc, @timestamp, null)), dc_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_dc, 1, null)),
    ps_last = MAX(CASE(is_ps, event.ingested, null)), ps_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_ps, @timestamp, null)), ps_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_ps, 1, null)),
    ai_last = MAX(CASE(is_ai, event.ingested, null)), ai_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_ai, @timestamp, null)), ai_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_ai, 1, null)),
    sy_last = MAX(CASE(is_sy, event.ingested, null)), sy_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_sy, @timestamp, null)), sy_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_sy, 1, null)),
    cr_last = MAX(CASE(is_cr, event.ingested, null)), cr_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_cr, @timestamp, null)), cr_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_cr, 1, null)),
    threshold_stale_hours = COALESCE(MAX(threshold_stale_hours), 36.0)
| EVAL bc_age = CASE(bc_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", bc_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       rp_age = CASE(rp_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", rp_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       pc_age = CASE(pc_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", pc_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       dc_age = CASE(dc_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", dc_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       ps_age = CASE(ps_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", ps_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       ai_age = CASE(ai_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", ai_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       sy_age = CASE(sy_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", sy_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       cr_age = CASE(cr_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", cr_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null)
| EVAL e_bc = CASE(bc_cnt == 0 OR bc_last IS NULL OR bc_age > threshold_stale_hours, CONCAT("serverless_billing_cost_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(bc_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_billing_cost_lookup` transform output is missing or stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(bc_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_rp = CASE(rp_cnt == 0 OR rp_last IS NULL OR rp_age > threshold_stale_hours, CONCAT("serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(rp_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup` transform output is missing or stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(rp_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_pc = CASE(pc_cnt == 0 OR pc_last IS NULL OR pc_age > threshold_stale_hours, CONCAT("serverless_project_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(pc_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_project_contribution_lookup` transform output is missing or stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(pc_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_dc = CASE(dc_cnt == 0 OR dc_last IS NULL OR dc_age > threshold_stale_hours, CONCAT("serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(dc_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup` transform output is missing or stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(dc_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_ps = CASE(ps_cnt > 0 AND (ps_last IS NULL OR ps_age > threshold_stale_hours), CONCAT("serverless_project_status_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(ps_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_project_status_lookup` transform output is stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(ps_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_ai = CASE(ai_cnt > 0 AND (ai_last IS NULL OR ai_age > threshold_stale_hours), CONCAT("serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(ai_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup` transform output is stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(ai_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_sy = CASE(sy_cnt > 0 AND (sy_last IS NULL OR sy_age > threshold_stale_hours), CONCAT("serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(sy_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup` transform output is stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(sy_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_cr = CASE(cr_cnt > 0 AND (cr_last IS NULL OR cr_age > threshold_stale_hours), CONCAT("serverless_billing_credits_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(cr_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_billing_credits_lookup` transform output is stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(cr_cnt), ")."), null)
| EVAL _raw = CONCAT(CASE(e_bc IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_bc, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_rp IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_rp, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_pc IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_pc, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_dc IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_dc, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_ps IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_ps, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_ai IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_ai, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_sy IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_sy, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_cr IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_cr, "\n"), ""))
| WHERE _raw != ""
| EVAL entries = SPLIT(_raw, "\n")
| MV_EXPAND entries
| WHERE entries != ""
| DISSECT entries "%{idx_group}\t%{last_ingested}\t%{last_doc_ts}\t%{age_hours}\t%{doc_count_str}\t%{result}"
| EVAL doc_count = TO_INTEGER(doc_count_str)
| KEEP result, idx_group, last_ingested, last_doc_ts, age_hours, doc_count, threshold_stale_hours
